description: Declared dependency graph over revision artifact index ids. The edit-intent plan compiler classifies artifacts as regenerate/revalidate/stale/reuse by walking these declared edges; any index artifact matched by no rule has unknown dependency coverage, which blocks selective-execution claims. Edges follow the proven invalidation semantics of scripts/create_successor_revision.py (identity source -> storyboard frames -> storyboard packet -> media lock -> provider packet).

rules.note: Accepted contact-sheet identity source; per create_successor_revision.py the successor identity binding derives from the durable qualification receipt. Edit intents never target it (out of scope).
Storyboard panel start frames derive from the accepted identity source (see STALE_TARGET_ARTIFACTS in create_successor_revision.py).
Storyboard panel end frames derive from the accepted identity source.
Storyboard packet consumes every panel frame.
Media lock binds the storyboard packet and its frames (phase_08_media_lock/storyboard_media_lock_manifest.json).
Per-frame generation receipts document the generation event of a specific frame; when that frame is replaced they become stale historical evidence, never silently reused.
Provider packets derive from the media lock; per STALE_SOURCE_ARTIFACTS in create_successor_revision.py they are superseded historical evidence, not reusable.
Phase 01 idea artifacts are upstream of all panel work; a panel edit never affects them.
Phase 01 idea artifacts are upstream of all panel work; a panel edit never affects them.

catch_all.note: Index artifacts matched by no rule have unknown dependency coverage. The plan compiler still emits a plan, but selective_execution.claimed is false and blocked_by carries BLOCKED_COVERAGE_UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY.
